description: KNa₂NiO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Ni and two O atoms. There are a spread of K-Ni bond distances ranging from 3.13-3.23 Å. There is one shorter (2.83 Å) and one longer (3.09 Å) K-O bond length. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one O atom. The K-O bond length is 2.82 Å. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.38 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.37 Å) and two longer (2.39 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.42 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded in a linear geometry to three equivalent K and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.79 Å) and one longer (1.80 Å) Ni-O bond length. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded in a linear geometry to one K and two O atoms. Both Ni-O bond lengths are 1.80 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, four Na, and one Ni atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ni atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, four Na, and one Ni atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, four Na, and one Ni atom.
